answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Reaching the dune of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Each submission hangs on the summit of a task receipt, and the river is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
